title: Service Contracts: volume rebate figures by tier
content:
## Scope
This reference lists the volume rebate figures of each Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts tier: when the rebate is accrued, the lifting threshold above which it is earned, the rebate per FEU, the cap per term, the smallest balance that is paid out and how the rebate is settled.

## Parameters by tier
| Tier | Accrued | Threshold (% of the commitment assessed) | Rebate (USD per FEU above threshold) | Cap (USD per term) | Minimum payout (USD) | Settled by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | at term end | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | credit note |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | at term end | 110 | 15.00 | 5000.00 | 50.00 | credit note |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | at term end | 110 | 20.00 | 20000.00 | 100.00 | credit note |
| AHL Key Account Contract | quarterly | 105 | 25.00 | 60000.00 | 250.00 | credit note |
| AHL Global Account Contract | quarterly | 105 | 30.00 | 150000.00 | 500.00 | cash |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | quarterly | 100 | 40.00 | 500000.00 | 1000.00 | cash |

## What each figure means
- **Threshold**: the lifting, as a percent of the commitment assessed, above which the rebate is earned; a threshold of 0 means the tier earns no rebate.
- **Rebate per FEU**: the amount earned for each FEU lifted above the threshold.
- **Cap**: the largest rebate accrued in one term.
- **Minimum payout**: the accrued rebate below which settlement is deferred to the next settlement date.
- **Settled by**: credit note or cash.

## Quick questions
**Does an AHL Starter Service Contract earn a volume rebate?** No. Its threshold is 0, which marks a tier that earns none.

**How is a rebate on an AHL Key Account Contract paid out?** By credit note; the Global Account and Strategic Partner tiers are settled in cash.

**Which tier earns from the first FEU above the full commitment?** The AHL Strategic Partner Contract, whose threshold is 100 % of the commitment assessed; the Key Account and Global Account tiers start above 105 %, the Standard and Regional Account tiers above 110 %.
